meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 就能通过 Microsoft Teams 收发消息:你可以在团队频道、群聊或私聊里直接和它对话;它还会给绑定的账号主动发送第一条消息。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Microsoft Teams 集成,或要求把助手接入 Teams 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Microsoft Teams 支持
say.note: 开始安装 Teams 适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 把 Teams 频道接到这个助手
say.note: 会检查依赖并提示输入隧道 URL 和应用名称。

say.text: 接入 Teams,让我在频道里收到回复
say.note: 安装完成后会引导绑定账号并安装应用到 Teams。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can send and receive messages through Microsoft Teams: chat directly in team channels, group chats, or DMs. It also proactively sends the first message to the linked account.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Microsoft Teams integration or connect the assistant to Teams.

say_en.text: Help me add Microsoft Teams support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts the Teams adapter installation and guided setup.

say_en.text: Connect the Teams channel to this assistant
say_en.note: Checks dependencies and prompts for tunnel URL and app name.

say_en.text: Add Teams so I can chat in channels
say_en.note: By the end, it guides account linking and app install in Teams.
